evidence: The film thickness and refractive index were measured by ellipsometry, which was calibrated by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy. The amount of Pb deposited was measured by X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF, Spectrace Co., model QuanX) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Kratos, AXIS). XPS was also used to confirm the oxidation states of Pb. The film surface morphology was examined by atomic force microscopy (AFM, JEOL, JSPM-5200) in tapping mode with a Pt/Ti–coated Si tip.
